title: Aligned stock table
description: Print the rows as an aligned text table. The name column is as wide as the longest name but at least 4 characters wide; the quantity column is as wide as the longest quantity written in decimal but at least 3 characters wide. The first line is the word `item` padded on the right with spaces to the name width, then ` | ` (space, bar, space), then the word `qty` padded on the left with spaces to the quantity width. The second line is as many dashes as the name width, then `-+-`, then as many dashes as the quantity width. After that print one line per row, in order, in the same layout: the name padded on the right, ` | `, the quantity padded on the left. Quantities are never negative; names have no line breaks and may contain spaces, which are kept. Return the width of one table line (name width + 3 + quantity width). An empty list still prints the first two lines.
notes: Level 3. Two passes (measure, then print) with padding on both sides. Minimum widths 4 and 3 apply even for an empty list; a quantity of 0 is one character; a name of exactly 4 characters adds no padding; the quantity is the last column, so its left padding is the only trailing layout. Largest quantity 9e15 (16 digits).
